content: मूर्तिः {%f.%} [मूर्च्छ्-क्तिन्] .²1 Anything which has definite shape and limits, material element, matter, substance; एतत् सर्वं यन्मूर्तं चामूर्तं च तस्मान्मूर्तिरेव रयिः <ls>Praśna. Up. 1. 5</ls>. .²2 A form, visible shape, body, figure; कौटिल्यधीरज्जुनिबद्धमूर्तिं मन्ये स्थिरां मौर्यनृपस्य लक्ष्मीम् <ls>Mu. 2. 2</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 27</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 54</ls>. .²3 An embodiment, incarnation, personification, manifestation; करुणस्य मूर्तिः <ls>U. 3. 4</ls>; <ls>Pt. 2. 159</ls>. .²4 An image, idol, a statue. .²5 Beauty. .²6 Solidity, hardness. .²7 Body (कलेवर); विशिखसंहतितापितमूर्तिभिः <ls>Ki. 14. 64</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 17</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 1.">19</ls>. .²8 A limb of the body (शरीरावयव); नहि मे तप्यमानस्य क्षयं यास्यन्ति मूर्तयः <ls>Rām. 1. 64. 20</ls>. .²9 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) The mind and the four elements -earth, air, fire and water.
